description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to further enlarged the time upto 31.12.2017 of the Commission of Inquiry of the Issuance of Treasury Bonds
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of time for a Commission of Inquiry to render its report, specifically referencing the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393). The content is focused on a legal/regulatory procedure (extending a statutory deadline) and references previous legal notifications. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or elections.
